one_line: The paper describes the U.S. DOE Superior Energy Performance (SEP) voluntary certification program built on ISO 50001, aimed broadly at industrial and commercial facilities of all types, with pilot results from a mixed range of manufacturing plants—not an application to any specific continuous-flow production process.
